Our Programs

1. Health and Wellness Promotion

This Programme aims for male involvement in achieving the targets of SDG 3 and contributing to its targets in Primary Health Care by creating awareness and educating the boys and men on their roles and responsibilities.

  • Triple Threat
  • Mental Health
  • Teen Fathers
  • Alcohol and Drug Abuse
  • Primary Health Care
  • Maternal Health

2. Education, Training and Research

To achieve Education for Sustainable Development, this programme will advocate for male involvement in achieving SDG 4 and its objectives and targets.

  • Vocational Training and Life Skill Development
  • School Commodity Support
  • Research and Learning

3. Governance and Leadership

This programme will advocate for male involvement in achieving the objectives and targets of SDG 16.

  • Strategic Leadership
  • Civic Education, Transparency and Accountability

4. Environmental Conservation and Climate Change Adaptation

This programme aims to achieve the objectives of SDG 13.

  • Environment and Climate Change Education, Awareness, and Capacity Building

5. Economic Strengthening

This programme aims to achieve the objectives and targets of SDG 8.

  • Innovation and Technological Advancement
{/*
  • Health & Wellness – SDG 3 focus on Mental Health, Teen Fathers, Drug Abuse, and Primary Health Care.
  • Education & Research – SDG 4 focus with vocational training and school support.
  • Governance & Leadership – SDG 16 focus with civic education and strategic leadership.
  • Environment – SDG 13 focus with climate change awareness.
  • Economic Strengthening – SDG 8 focus with innovation and vocational skills.
*/}
); } export default Programs;
